coaching.headline: No tank into Steel and Kaelen, river camps lost 23 to 1, every Fangtooth conceded and a 0-5 wipe at mid.

flags.text: Lost 0-5 at mid: Drongo killed three, took the mid outer, and the offlane outer and Shaper followed.
Legion died 11 damn times, the game's most, eight to Kira; Kira finished 10/3/6.
Enemy took river camps 23 to 1 and all three Fangtooths, two to Kaelen, one to Kira.
Two divers, Scarlett and Serath, and zero tanks; enemy hard crowd control ran ahead 10 to 6.

focus.title: Let the enemy engage first
focus.action: With no tank, let Steel or Kaelen engage first and turn after Shield Slam and Frostfall are spent; Legion holds beside Dekker until then, and Valmont and Serath contest the river camps.

15.9.call: Lost 1-4 in separate plays: Kira and Mourn killed Legion and Dekker on the duo lane while Kaelen killed Serath and Scarlett on the offlane. When Kaelen shows offlane, back off to tower.

18.4.call: Won 4-0 with two kills from Valmont, yet Kira took Fangtooth during the fight and no allied prize followed. After a won fight, hit the nearest enemy tower.

21.5.call: Kaelen, Drongo and Kira took all five allied lives without losing one, and the mid outer fell straight after. Without a tank, wait out Frostfall and Gag Grenade before committing.

8124100e-f6c8-472c-9daf-d955c76c48d8: Carried the fucking damage: 31997 to heroes, the game's most, with five kills on Drongo. When Drongo is low after a trade, keep forcing the lane fight.
Two of four deaths went to Kaelen, and four kills on other lanes never led to an allied prize. After a rotation kill, call the team onto the nearest tower.
One river camp taken while the enemy took 23. When the mid wave is pushed, take the nearer river camp before Drongo does.
7936d890-541e-4701-9265-076b5ebedc7b: Eight of eleven deaths went to Kira, three before ten minutes. Kira is slowed while firing Purge: save crowd control for that window before trading.
Took the enemy duo outer, the only allied structure, then Kira killed both duo players soon after. After a tower falls, back off until Kira is seen.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Three of five deaths went to Steel, one shortly before the first enemy Fangtooth. Trade with Steel only after Shield Slam is spent.
Two of the Steel kills came outside any detected fight. When Steel opens with Bull Rush, hold Swan Song until the unstoppable charge ends, then commit.
e2cb25f9-7c46-43ef-b7f1-d4314d4945b4: Thirteen wards matched an own average of 13.2, but the enemy cleared eight wards to the team's two. Before each Fangtooth, refresh wards on the pit entrances.
Kill participation 47% with no deaths before ten minutes, while Legion died three times early. When Kira trades onto Legion, land Stasis Bomb on Kira first.
9ac0db1b-cdb9-4d9c-b6a9-d1ad113441df: Seven deaths, two to Kaelen and one to Mourn just before Kaelen took the last Fangtooth. Before each Fangtooth, call Valmont and Legion to the pit first.
Invaded hard: 98 of 200 jungle minions came from the enemy jungle. Keep invading when Kaelen shows on a far lane, and back out when Kaelen is unseen.

matchup: Drongo was the lane opponent: five of nine kills landed on Drongo, and Drongo killed back twice.
This mid field wins 51.5% into Drongo over 39 games.
build: Tainted Scepter answered Kira's healing but finished last, so only the final fight had the anti-heal.
Combustion's Pyro adds area damage on ability hits, and hitting heroes shortens the Pyro cooldown.
Soulbinder adds bonus damage only when abilities hit heroes from long range.
eternal: Vesh adds a damage-over-time to ability damage on heroes; Mind Rot adds current-health damage to the major.
Aion holds the best odds in a toss-up mid field; Vesh, the most played, ranks below Aion and Demiurge.
Under Vesh, Lich with Phylactery is the best pair; the Lich and Mind Rot run trails.
augment: Sanguine Banquet grants omnivamp that scales with bonus mana, and minion kills raise max mana.
Sanguine Banquet holds the best odds in a toss-up augment field. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed for a few seconds.
Epoch is the Best crest pick here, clearly ahead of Soulbearer, with the same stats.
improvement: Into Drongo the field buys Dreambinder more, 29% against a usual 17%, winning 53.1%; Dreambinder slows on ability damage.
Anti-heal need met; finish Tainted Scepter before Soulbinder so Kira's healing is cut earlier.
Epoch over Soulbearer swaps the lifesteal shield active for a stasis active.

matchup: Kira was the lane opponent: first blood landed on Kira, then eight of eleven deaths went to Kira.
The field wins 51.7% of this carry matchup over 1123 games.
build: Malady, Deathstalker and Vanquisher is the standard opening; Vanquisher executes heroes below 5% health.
Deathstalker shreds physical armor on basic attacks, useful into the Forticus on Steel, Kaelen and Mourn.
Across three items and Witchstalker, nothing added armor or anti-heal against Kira.
eternal: Demiurge raises item stats and item-effect damage by 10%.
Knell holds the best odds in a toss-up carry field, level with Lotus and Xyris; Demiurge ranks fourth.
Under Demiurge, Construct with Bloatware is the best pair; Tri-Core with Memory Leak trails.
augment: Press the Advantage spawns a Rally Point on takedowns; three kills and two assists left few spawns.
Scorched Earth is the Best augment here, clearly ahead of Press the Advantage.
crest: Witchstalker's active cleanses all debuffs and deals max-health true damage, doubled after a cleanse.
Witchstalker sits level with Epoch atop a toss-up crest field. Sound keep.
improvement: Tainted Rounds, NOT built, is the suggested anti-heal into Kira; slot Tainted Rounds before Vanquisher.
Physical armor, NOT built, was the other need, with eight of eleven deaths going to Kira.
The suggested core runs Malady, Infernum and The Perforator at 60.5% over 583 games.

matchup: Steel was the lane opponent: three of five deaths went to Steel, and the one kill on Steel came early.
Took more magical damage from heroes than physical, 10894 against 8218.
This offlane field wins 51.5% into Steel over 341 games.
build: Tainted Blade cuts the target's healing on physical damage, meeting the anti-heal need into Kira.
Mutilator, finished last, is bought by 53% of the field into Steel against a usual 42%.
Alternata, evolved from Alternator, adds damage to the alternate ability and trims other cooldowns.
eternal: Knell's Rust shreds physical and magical armor on hits and grants part of the shredded armor.
Nihil and Knell sit level atop a toss-up offlane field. Sound keep.
Patina with Peal is the best Knell pair in this field.
augment: Volcaic Slam makes Empowered Cindara leave a rupture that erupts for damage and a slow.
Volcaic Slam leans ahead in this offlane field. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active deals area damage and heals on hero hits.
Brutallax and Ortus share the best odds in a toss-up crest field; Judgement, the most played, ranks lower.
Brutallax keeps Judgement's stats and trades the heal active for a cleanse with tenacity.
improvement: Salvation, NOT built, is the suggested tenacity item against the hard crowd control of Steel, Kaelen, Drongo and Mourn.
Magical armor, NOT built, was the listed answer to three of five deaths going to Steel.
Into Steel the field buys The Perforator more, 39% against a usual 22%, winning 54%.

matchup: Mourn and Kira were the duo opponents: one kill on Mourn, one death each to Mourn and Kira.
The field wins 47.2% of this support matchup over 826 games.
build: Crescelia and Timewarp open the best core into Mourn, 60.9% over 69 games, with Dynamo third.
Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage, an answer to the healing of Mourn and Kira.
eternal: Lotus leans ahead in this support field; Vesh, the most played, ranks near the bottom.
Under Vesh, Lich with Mind Rot is the best pair; Tithe of Death with Mind Rot trails.
augment: Photon Efficiency adds damage to Photon Disruptor and cuts the cooldown on hero hits.
Nothin' But Net is the Best augment here, clearly ahead of Photon Efficiency.
crest: Leafsong's active speeds nearby allies and makes allies immune to slows; Visionary raises the ward cap to three.
Leafsong holds the best odds in a toss-up support crest field. Sound keep.
improvement: Dynamo, NOT built, completes both suggested cores, 57.8% and 60.9%, and adds physical armor against Kira.
Magical armor, NOT built, was the listed need into Mourn.
Nothin' But Net over Photon Efficiency is the field-backed augment swap: gold and power from Stasis Bomb hits.

matchup: Kaelen was the jungle opponent: two kills on this jungler, two Fangtooths, the Shaper and six wards cleared.
The field wins 41.5% of this jungle matchup over 670 games.
build: Sky Splitter deals current-health damage on hits, strongest against healthy frontliners like Kaelen and Steel.
Tainted Rounds met the anti-heal need against Kira.
Spectra, finished last, completed the most played core into Kaelen, 45.2% over 93 games.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack: more damage dealt to that hero, less taken.
Weald and Xyris share the best odds in a toss-up jungle field; Thraex ranks last of the well-played options.
Savage Strikes with Ferocity is the best Thraex pair here.
augment: Crushing Descent adds a brief stun when Ascend deals damage.
Crushing Descent holds the best odds in a toss-up augment field. Sound keep.
crest: Eviscerator's active adds attack speed, omnivamp and on-hit damage for a few seconds.
Liberator leans ahead in this jungle field; Eviscerator, the most played, ranks lower.
improvement: Anti-heal need met. Storm Breaker over Spectra completes the suggested core, 64.5% over 220 games.
Liberator over Eviscerator keeps the same stats and swaps the attack-speed active for a cleanse and shield.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Arterial Grip to ground and slow → Bloodbound for attack speed → basics to trigger Hemophagia → Exsanguinate bats to heal
ourKits.winCondition: bind a target with Arterial Grip and out-sustain them with Hemophagia strikes and Exsanguinate's healing
ourKits.passive: Hemophagia makes Lilith strike targets hit by his basics or Bloodbound, and takedowns restore mana
ourKits.playWith: frontliners who keep enemies in range so his bind and bats keep landing
ourKits.playAgainst: Arterial Grip breaks if you CC him, break line of sight, or get far enough away; buy anti-heal against Exsanguinate and magical armor

ourKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
ourKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
ourKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
ourKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

ourKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
ourKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
ourKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Containment Fence traps a target, Stasis Bomb stuns from range, Ion Strike blasts to stun the center and slow the edge, and Photon Disruptor slows
ourKits.winCondition: trap a target in the fence and chain stuns so the team collapses
ourKits.passive: jumping mid-air fires Rocket Boots upward and speeds nearby allies; abilities cut its cooldown
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun and fence into a kill
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb, whose stun gets longer the farther it travels; step out of the Ion Strike center during its delay; stay out of the fence ring or flank around it; tenacity shortens her stuns

ourKits.combo: Ascend to dive onto the backline, Chastise to slow and reset her basic attack, Heaven's Fury to go untargetable and strike, then Heresy for speed, attack speed and true-damage burns.
ourKits.winCondition: Dive the backline, get the first takedown and chain free Heresy activations from Fallen Grace.
ourKits.passive: Fallen Grace: hero takedowns drop a visage that, when touched, activates Heresy for free and cuts her basic ability cooldowns.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline that creates her dive angle and CC that holds targets for her.
ourKits.playAgainst: Do not waste CC or burst during Heaven's Fury, since she is invulnerable then; hit her as she lands from Ascend. Deny the first kill so she cannot pick up the visage.

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slows on the way out and back, Gag Grenade silences, Rad Rounds stacks Irradiate on basics, then Shrapnel Cannon shreds armor and erupts Irradiate
enemyKits.winCondition: kite from range, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, and use Shrapnel Cannon to shred or escape
enemyKits.passive: critical strikes and ability hits apply a max-health bleed
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
enemyKits.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
enemyKits.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
enemyKits.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
enemyKits.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
enemyKits.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

enemyKits.combo: Abduct to pull a target in, Beguile to Mesmerize the group, Contagion to heal allies and shred enemy armor, and Eclipse to blind the enemy team's vision and spread Contagion map-wide.
enemyKits.winCondition: Pull a target into his team with Abduct, lock the fight with Beguile and keep allies healthy with Contagion.
enemyKits.passive: Extract: his next basic attack cleaves for bonus damage and restores health.
enemyKits.playWith: Burst damage that punishes his pulled or Mesmerized target and benefits from the armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Abduct and Beguile are both visible channels that slow Mourn, so sidestep the vines and walk out of the growing Beguile radius before it erupts. Anti-heal blunts Contagion and Extract.

checks.text: No real tank: nobody to start fights or take the first hits for the backline.
Out-tanked 0 v 2: teams two tanks down won 45.7% in 1.18.
2 divers (Scarlett, Serath): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
One main mage and one main marksman at most.
Dekker can stay with the carry and peel.

evidence: Legion died 8 of 11 times to Kira.
Play against Kira: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.
Item answer: Anti-heal: Tainted Rounds.

gameFlags.summary: Scarlett kept dying to Steel (3 of 5)
evidence: Scarlett died 3 of 5 times to Steel.
Steel's hard CC: Shield Bash (stun), Bull Rush (knockback), Shield Slam (knock-up + stun).
Play against Steel: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown
Item answer: Tenacity: Salvation.

They brought 10 hard-CC abilities to our 6. Fight after Steel's Shield Slam and Kaelen's Frostfall and Drongo's Gag Grenade are used, spread out instead of grouping in a line, and the front line can buy tenacity.
Theirs: Drongo Gag Grenade, Drongo Shrapnel Cannon, Steel Shield Bash, Steel Bull Rush, Steel Shield Slam, Kaelen Rimefang, Kaelen Winter's Pursuit, Kaelen Frostfall, Mourn Abduct, Mourn Beguile.

bullets: An ability cast empowered Kira's next basic attack within 4s through Solaris, healing Kira for 50% of that damage; Ashbringer hits trimmed non-ultimate cooldowns, once per ability.
After enough unit kills, Bone Collector gave permanent critical strike chance, so more basic attacks gained Imperator's 30% critical bonus and Iron Will's larger critical-strike healing.
Xyris gave bonus damage that grew with units killed, up to a cap, so steady farming raised the damage of Mercy, Purge and every basic attack.
Adaptive Plating stacked matching armor from hits taken, up to a cap, beside Cybernetic Shell and Stonewall; From the Abyss restored health each second in hero combat.
Any hero hit, like Shield Bash or Bull Rush, started Nihil's Doom, adding power and both armors the longer Doom lasted; takedowns and level-ups permanently raised those gains.
Fire Blossom's burn grew each second Steel kept burning a target, up to 40%; Forticus added max health and speed in hero trades, lost after the 3s timer.
By the end, 40 ability haste cut Exsanguinate to about 3.6s, so bat swarms hit heroes far more often; Combustion's burst kept a separate cooldown.
Vesh added damage over time after Rupture, Bloodbound and Exsanguinate hit heroes; Mind Rot added current-health damage to that damage over time, and Lich gave magical lifesteal.
Bats returning from heroes restored Valmont 8x the health; Tainted Scepter, finished late, jumped to 15 Malice stacks on a takedown, raising ability damage on heroes.
